title: PostgreSQL
description: Become a database expert. Master PostgreSQL transactions, indexing techniques, stored procedures, replication setups, and schema tuning.

nodes.title: ACID & Transaction isolation
nodes.description: Master database locking, transactional ACID properties, isolation levels (Read Committed, Serializable), and MVCC.
projectIdeas: Write SQL script loops demonstrating Read Phenomenons (Dirty read, Phantom read) across multiple connection tabs.
interviewQuestions: What is MVCC (Multi-Version Concurrency Control) in Postgres?
Explain how Read Committed isolation level operates.

nodes.title: Indexing & Query Plans (EXPLAIN)
nodes.description: Build B-Tree, GIN, and GiST indexes. Analyze queries performance using EXPLAIN ANALYZE plan dumps.
projectIdeas: Build a B-Tree index on a table containing 1 million rows, and show how query scan moves from Sequential Scan to Index Scan.
interviewQuestions: When would you use a GIN index instead of a B-Tree index in Postgres?
What does 'Sequential Scan' indicate in an EXPLAIN dump?

nodes.title: PL/pgSQL stored procedures & triggers
nodes.description: Write database routines, trigger actions on inserts, clean data, and construct auditing structures.
projectIdeas: Build a trigger that logs previous database column state rows into an audit history table whenever updates happen.
interviewQuestions: What is the difference between a database function and a stored procedure?
Explain trigger execution boundaries (BEFORE vs AFTER).
